about.label: About
about.title: From technical training to software engineering
about.p1: I am a junior software engineer focused on backend and full stack. I have experience with web and mobile, APIs, integrations, automation, cloud, databases and hardware projects.
about.p2: My foundation comes from the Systems Development technical course at Etec Registro, and continues in the Multiplatform Software Development degree at Fatec Registro, with graduation expected in December 2028.
about.p3: Alongside that, I founded BYTHE, where I apply engineering to real problems: I gather requirements, make technical decisions, and deliver and evolve solutions together with clients.
about.goal: A Junior Software Engineer, Backend or Full Stack role, including remote, in Curitiba or São Paulo.

bythe.title: BYTHE
bythe.description: Founding and hands-on work in engineering and development: requirements gathering and analysis of real problems, full stack web systems with TypeScript, React, Next.js and Node.js, APIs, databases and integrations, infrastructure and cloud, automation, technical decisions, evolution of solutions, and client communication through to delivery.

wacs.title: WACS
wacs.description: Assistive technology system for wheelchairs, built by a team at Etec Registro. It combines a mobile app, Arduino hardware and accessibility mapping; academic prototype presented at FETEPS (7th place, as reported).

teaching.title: Technology and Computing teacher and instructor
teaching.description: Worked as a Technology and Computing teacher and instructor in professional qualification courses, in initiatives tied to Centro Paula Souza and Fundo Social, during periods in 2026. The experience strengthened technical and teaching communication.
